answer: Give every agent a work history that cannot be bought: each identity must tend its own orchard of completed, countersigned jobs, and only agents with a deep, aged record may transact at scale. A fresh identity is an ember — it can spark, but it holds no heat until it has done months of real work. Back each record with a copper bond that forfeits on fraud, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds and a thousand slow histories.
